# Marilla Cuthbert

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with angles and no curves, whose dark hair is streaked with gray and bound in a tight knot with wire hairpins. Over time, her hair turns grayer and her appearance grows gaunt, old, worn, and tired. In her childhood, she was a dark and homely girl.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v3 c40 P13](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0013)_

## Personality

Marilla is a practical, sensible, and stern woman of narrow experience, rigid conscience, and stoic deportment. Though brusque, repressed, and unromantic, she possesses a dry, subtle sense of humor and a deep, soft heart that she hesitates to express openly. She is economical, clean, precise, and easily anxious or pessimistic about her responsibilities.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v2 c19 P64](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0064), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)_

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived at Green Gables her whole life with her brother Matthew. Deciding to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm, they were mistakenly sent Anne Shirley, whom Marilla agreed to keep and raise. Despite her strict nature, Marilla grew deeply attached to Anne as she mentored her into womanhood. Following Matthew's death and a period of failing eyesight, she took in the orphaned Keith twins, Davy and Dora. Over the years, her lifelong friendship with Rachel Lynde deepened, leading Rachel to move in with her at Green Gables. Marilla took great pride and quiet joy in Anne's academic successes and eventual marriage to Gilbert Blythe, the son of her former youth courtier John Blythe. In her later years, she ventured beyond Avonlea for the first time to visit Anne and Gilbert in Four Winds.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P28](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0028), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017), [v4 c1 P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005), [v4 c2 P8](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0008), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016), [v4 c15 P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001)_
